ETH.note: States no share of people using the internet.

facts.fact: Freedom House reports localised connectivity restrictions continued in Amhara Region, citing Addis Standard's February 2026 report of phone and internet outages in North Shewa Zone.

Freedom House reports Ethiopian authorities revoked independent digital outlet Addis Standard's licence in February 2026, citing CPJ, and an Addis Standard editor was seized from its newsroom in April 2026.
